fusions.name: Lancing Draw
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. The claw deals 8 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 0.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Musk Burst
fusions.desc: Sprays musk in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 12 poison damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Nothing Soaks Through
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Bitter Hide
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
